question: How are the different groupings of the goddesses formed?
premises: The same goddesses can be invoked or withdrawn.
The numbers range from one up to nine and beyond.
inference: The numerical classifications of the goddesses arise from their invocation and withdrawal.
plain_english: And through the invocation and withdrawal of these very goddesses, they are arranged in groups of one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, and more.
